newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 steel output near 100 mln T - Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 steel output near 100 mln T - Xinhua.

text.p: China is expected to produce nearly 100 million tonnes of steel this year, up from 93.5 million tonnes in 1995, the Xinhua news agency said.
Output of steel products would be above 82 million tonnes in 1996, the official agency said in a report late on Friday.
China would produce more than 110 million tonnes of steel a year by 2000, while output of steel products would exceed 96 million tonnes, under state industry plans, it said.
Output of high-quality steel plate and steel tube reached 32 million tons in 1995, accounting for 37.6 percent of the year's total rolled steel output, it said.
